first-attestation-floor: Change only top-level source_generation serial to max(serial,1) when source_name is nonempty; otherwise preserve it. Preserve namespace and all nested objects exactly.
transition_observation: Exact decision string for every modeled action, plus append_reply for append and append-lose-reply operations.
shared_action_translation: Same original action at projected S prestate, retaining S scheduling bookkeeping for local Q calls only.
source_only_operations: register, attempt, atomic, append, collect, append-lose-reply and collect-open have no Q translation and cannot stutter away their responses.
scope: Conservative modeled observation contract; no claim this is a selected product API.
controls: Certificate, projection, observation and coverage corruptions only. No new original protocol guard/input mutations.
restricted_barrier: Consecutive retained attestation/stage requires one shared target generation to equal both token1 and token0 if all other observed fields remain exact.
